thread:
Priyanka: FYI customer 'AuroraHealth' hit a hard blocker during private deploy. Marketplace image fails image-auth behind their proxy. Need arch + SI triage. :warning:
Mira: on it. error logs?
Priyanka: paste from the node: ```ERROR: image signature verification failed: manifest digest mismatch
fetching from https://marketplace.redwood.example/aurora-image:403
proxy error: upstream reset```
Jon: curious if this is a proxy TLS inspection issue or our signed image metadata being rewritten by the customer's gateway.
Sam: @Mira can you confirm if the marketplace signing key rotated last week?
Mira: No rotation on our side. Last rotation was 2025-11-03. Customer says their security appliance rewrites headers for auth.
Lucas: This also lines up with an unrelated ticket: the customer's edge NIC firmware is old and drops large TLS records occasionally. Could cause partial manifest fetch.
Anna (FieldEng): I can join a call with the customer's infra team. They have a F5 in front of the private VPC and a Sentinel appliance doing header munging.
Priyanka: Need a short-term workaround to unblock the deploy and a long-term plan. Proposed workaround: 1) bypass proxy for registry host via routing, 2) re-pull images through a relay in the customer's VPC, 3) if hardware NIC is flaky, schedule field eng firmware update.
Jon: Workaround 1 sounds fastest. Can engineering provide the registry FQDN to pin route?
Mira: Registry FQDN: marketplace-internal.redwood.internal. I'll DM the cert thumbprint.
Sam: I'll create a canary route in the customer's VPC tomorrow morning UTC to test bypass.
Priyanka: Also need SI to verify the deploy runbook — specifically image pull backoff behavior and retry counts. @Anna can you validate runbook steps and note gaps?
Anna (FieldEng): I'll run through runbook and add a step to validate TCP MSS and NIC firmware version before go-live.
OpsBot: deploy/relay-test started by Sam at 1725080000 — logs at https://ops.redwood/internal/logs/relay-test-1725080000
Mira: If bypass works, we should still record evidence for the partner hardware vendor (Sentinel) — they may need a hotfix for header rewriting on compressed manifests.
Lucas: I'll open a support case with Sentinel and attach packet captures. Can someone collect pcap from the failing node?
Priyanka: Anna can collect. Also, does anyone object to pushing a maintenance window and delaying final handoff by 4 hours to ensure firmware patching path works?
Jon: +1, prefer to avoid a bad go-live.
Sam: scheduled maintenance proposed: 2025-12-02T03:00Z — I'll post to the customer and the SI.
Priyanka: Thanks team. Action items: Sam = run bypass + report, Anna = collect pcap + runbook updates, Lucas = Sentinel case, Mira = cert thumbprint + verify signing chain, Jon = approve maintenance. I'll coordinate the SI handoff once we have bypass results. :thumbsup:
